decisions.english: Another log. For the cook, apparently.
decisions.afrikaans: Nog 'n stomp. Vir meer kole, natuurlik.

decisions.english: Your home repair list has requested an urgent update.
decisions.afrikaans: Jou huisherstellys het 'n dringende opdatering aangevra.

decisions.english: Flat sea, spent sun, and air still warm enough to sit around in a wet wetsuit.
decisions.afrikaans: Plat see, moeë son, en die lug nog warm genoeg om in 'n nat wetsuit rond te sit.

decisions.english: Quick dash. You have never timed one correctly.
decisions.afrikaans: Vinnige hardloop. Jy het nog nooit een reg gekry nie.

decisions.english: The charcoal is out, the sky is undecided, and neither is backing down.
decisions.afrikaans: Die houtskool is uit, die lug is onbeslis, en nie een gee kop nie.

decisions.english: The horizon kept one strip of orange as proof the sun was here.
decisions.afrikaans: Die horison het een strokie oranje behou as bewys dat die son hier was.

decisions.english: The windscreen kept a record of last night and she is deleting it by hand.
decisions.afrikaans: Die voorruit het gisteraand se rekord behou, en sy vee dit met die hand uit.

decisions.english: The blue half of the sky is on borrowed time and the lawns know it.
decisions.afrikaans: Die blou helfte van die lug leef op geleende tyd, en die grasperke weet dit.

decisions.english: How many warm-ups were you planning on doing?
decisions.afrikaans: Hoeveel opwarmings was jy van plan om te doen?

decisions.english: The sky is doing nothing in particular and being very thorough about it.
decisions.afrikaans: Die lug doen niks besonders nie en is baie deeglik daaroor.

decisions.english: Joburg winter dawn: the view is free; the air charges admission.
decisions.afrikaans: Joburg winterdagbreek: die uitsig is verniet; die lug vra toegangsgeld.

decisions.english: Your roof repair savings have been noticed.
decisions.afrikaans: Jou dakherstelspaargeld is raakgesien.

decisions.english: The late-night milk run has become a bigger request.
decisions.afrikaans: Die laatnag-melk-ekspedisie het 'n groter versoek geword.

decisions.english: The sun is trying its luck at the horizon and the cloud is unmoved.
decisions.afrikaans: Die son probeer sy geluk op die horison, en die wolke is onbeïndruk.

decisions.english: The pool is getting topped up for free tonight. Somewhere a water bill relaxes.
decisions.afrikaans: Die swembad word vanaand gratis vol gemaak. Iewers ontspan 'n waterrekening.

decisions.english: The first ten minutes of this Sunday belong to a credit card and the demister.
decisions.afrikaans: Die eerste tien minute van hierdie Sondag behoort aan 'n kredietkaart en die ontwaser.

decisions.english: Those sheets will be dry before she has pegged the last one on the line.
decisions.afrikaans: Daardie lakens gaan droog wees voor sy die laaste een opgehang het.

decisions.english: The tongs are out, so the argument about who cooks is over.
decisions.afrikaans: Die tang is uit, so die argument oor wie braai is verby.

decisions.english: That water was cold about forty minutes ago and nobody has topped it up.
decisions.afrikaans: Daardie water was omtrent veertig minute gelede koud en niemand het dit bygevul nie.

decisions.english: She is lying on tile rather than anything soft, and that was a decision.
decisions.afrikaans: Sy lê op teël eerder as op iets sags, en dit was 'n besluit.

decisions.english: Nobody has touched that car door and every one of them knows why.
decisions.afrikaans: Niemand het nog aan daardie kardeur geraak nie en elkeen van hulle weet hoekom.

decisions.english: Nobody in that building can open a window and every one of them has tried.
decisions.afrikaans: Niemand in daardie gebou kan 'n venster oopmaak nie en elkeen van hulle het probeer.

decisions.english: That water has been topped up twice and it is still the wrong temperature.
decisions.afrikaans: Daardie water is twee keer opgevul en dit is steeds die verkeerde temperatuur.

decisions.english: She is not looking for anything and both of us know it.
decisions.afrikaans: Sy soek niks nie en ons weet dit albei.

decisions.english: Frost on the grass, steam off the field: winter running weather at its most honest.
decisions.afrikaans: Ryp op die gras, stoom van die veld af: wintersdrafweer op sy eerlikste.

decisions.english: Joburg summer rain: arrives at five, soaks everything, gone by supper.
decisions.afrikaans: Joburg somerreën: kom vyfuur, deurweek alles, weg teen aandete.

decisions.english: The paving has stopped absorbing anything and is just passing it along.
decisions.afrikaans: Die plaveisel absorbeer niks meer nie en gee dit net aan.

decisions.english: The pool is being topped up by head office tonight, free of charge.
decisions.afrikaans: Die swembad word vanaand deur hoofkantoor vol gemaak, gratis.

decisions.english: Night rain maths: half the visibility, double the concentration, triple the respect.
decisions.afrikaans: Nagreënwiskunde: helfte die sig, dubbel die konsentrasie, drie keer die respek.

decisions.english: Fire up the Weber. It's the law.
decisions.afrikaans: Steek die Weber aan. Dit is die wet.

decisions.english: This weather has 'meh' written all over it.
decisions.afrikaans: Hierdie weer het 'n 'meh' houding.

decisions.english: Schrodinger's rain. It both is and isn't.
decisions.afrikaans: Schrödinger se reën. Dit is én is nie.

decisions.english: The moon has hung out a do-not-disturb sign.
decisions.afrikaans: Die maan het 'n 'moenie steur nie'-bordjie opgehang.

decisions.english: Even the seagulls are walking today.
decisions.afrikaans: Selfs die meeuë loop vandag.

decisions.english: The ice cream van is playing everyone's anthem.
decisions.afrikaans: Die roomyswa speel almal se volkslied.

decisions.english: Two drops on a windscreen and the whole N1 forgets everything it ever learned.
decisions.afrikaans: Twee druppels op die voorruit en die hele N1 vergeet hoe om te bestuur.

decisions.english: The sky just went full Carte Blanche.
decisions.afrikaans: Die lug het voluit bedonerd gegaan.
